frequency_question: How often does an emerging market central bank deploy an incremental reserve ratio tool within a given multi-year interval?
membership_rule: Members are major central banks classified under emerging economies that possess statutory authority to alter reserve requirements incrementally. Excluded are developed market central banks lacking this specific statutory mechanism.

known_gaps: Varying definitions of incremental versus headline reserve requirement changes across jurisdictions.
skeleton: 5 major emerging market central bank discretionary reserve requirement cycles observed across multiple jurisdictions over a decade.
multiplier: 5 observed policy deployment events across a standardized set of 20 comparable central-bank-years of liquidity surplus tightening.
validity_reason: Central bank statutory frameworks and standard monetary policy toolkits change slowly over multi-year horizons.
